thread:
sam: FYI — during the customer's POC demo we started seeing a burst of 5xxs around 10:15a PT. They were running 8 concurrent sessions hitting /v1/generate. Customer is on the call in ~20m, need a quick triage and a short-term mitigation :grimacing:

infra-bot: Autoscaler event: triggered scale-up x2 at 10:16:03. 2 new pods in Pending for ~60s. Image pull retries observed. Node provisioning in us-west-2 reported 1m provisioning latency.

maria: I pulled the logs — backlog on route /generate-prod climbed to ~120 requests, p50 token latency spiked, then steady 5xx once queue timed out. Looks like HPA reacted but pods couldn't schedule fast enough (image pull + bin packing). Autoscale cooldown was 60s, so we had a gap.

maria: Quick mitigations we can do now:
- reduce allowed concurrency per-client to 2 (on the route)
- enable fallback routing to model-v1-small (lower mem, faster spinup)
- temporarily route this customer to a dedicated pool if available

sam: Can we toggle fallback immediately from control plane or does it require a deployment?

maria: We can enable a fallback policy from the console (no deploy) — it routes to a pinned variant. I'll do that if we get agreement. ETA ~5-10m.

kevin: I'll ask the customer to drop concurrent sessions to 2 for now and retry. Also, question from them: will a fallback to smaller model affect POC metrics / cost?

sales-ops: For this POC incident we can waive any overage charges for today. Please document times and request IDs and I'll file a credit.

anita: I'll stay on the call and tell them the plan. Can eng confirm whether fallback will keep the same API contract (same response schema)? Don't want broken evals during demo.

maria: Fallback returns same schema, but token-level latency and completion length will differ. If they rely on exact logits/text granularity we shouldn't change model. But for demo continuity it's fine.

sam: Pasting a failing request/response snippet from logs:
```
REQUEST: POST /v1/generate route=/generate-prod client_id=acme-corp concurrency=8
{
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
RESPONSE: 500 Internal Server Error id=req_0a1b2c3d message=\"kernel OOM while dispatching\"
STACK: runtime: kernel oom at kv_cache_commit -> reclaim failed
```

maria: kernel OOM implies the model instance ran out of memory under concurrency pressure. Smaller variant fallback should avoid OOMs. Also planning: increase image pull parallelism and pre-warm nodes for the customer in their next scheduled run.

kevin: Customer agreed to reduce concurrency and try fallback. They asked about autoscale delay — is that something infra can tune (cooldowns/images) or a long-term infra change?

maria: Short term: increase warm pod pool for that tenant (requires infra approval) and bump image pull parallelism in the cluster config (I can request). Long term: we should reduce HPA cooldown for critical POCs and add node pre-provisioning for scheduled demos. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

sales-ops: Please include timestamps and request ids for credit claim. I'll handle communication to customer finance.

anita: Thanks. If we can get fallback live in 5-10m and confirm no schema break, we should be good for the demo. I'll note this in the CRM.

maria: Action items:
- enable fallback to model-v1-small for this route (I'll do now)
- set per-client concurrency cap to 2 (kevin + sam coordinating)
- open infra ticket to increase warm pool + image pull parallelism (maria)
- sales-ops to file credit (sales-ops)
- follow-up retro after demo to adjust HPA policies (maria + infra)

sam: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the channel after the customer retry.

kevin: Customer retried, results look good so far, no 5xx after fallback. Keeping on call for 10m to validate. :thumbsup:

maria: Monitoring now — qlen dropping, token latency back to baseline. I'll keep the fallback for 1 hour then revert once infra fixes are in place.

sales-ops: Credit filed (P-98321).

anita: Closing loop with customer, they were relieved. Will schedule a technical retro next week.

sam: Closing thread once retro scheduled. Thanks all!
